title: Nov 1 Opposition rally: It’s done bro; but what happened in France?

ai.summary: The author criticizes opposition parties for claiming 13 crore voters were 'dropped' during electoral-roll revision, clarifying that the figure refers to four categories: dead (2.8 crore), untraceable (3 crore), shifted (6.3 crore), and duplicate (1 crore) voters. The author emphasizes India's robust electoral system and contrasts peaceful protests with violent demonstrations in Europe.

facts.claim: opposition parties keep quoting the figure of 13 crore
facts.quote: On the number of voters ‘dropped’ – the opposition parties keep quoting the figure of 13 crore.

facts.claim: the figure actually refers to four categories
facts.quote:
— 2.8 crore names deleted — are Dead
— 3 crore voters — are officially untraceable or missing.
And 6.3 crore voters — are permanently shifted and one crore — Multiple Enrolment.

facts.claim: the electoral-roll process does not mean final list
facts.quote: Those who are debating these issues and even making allegations against Election Commission are not appreciating the fact that the ‘electoral-roll process’ does not mean final list. There are stages involving — claims, objections, verification and finalisation.

ai.background_note: The author clarifies the electoral-roll revision terminology and contrasts India's peaceful protest culture with violent demonstrations in Europe.
